statement_summary: Security lead and Food Defense Coordinator designated in writing
Annual risk assessment including control-system adulteration scenarios
Risk register feeds the food defense reanalysis decision
OT change control with FSQA approval and food defense check
Sanctions, including for tampering with controls or records
Vendor security terms and annual review of critical vendors
Unique accounts on HMIs, SCADA, recipe system, and records application
Two-person approval for formulation and critical setpoint changes
MFA for all remote OT access and cloud administration
OT remote access only through the gateway with approved, recorded sessions
Same-day removal of IT and OT access at termination
Default passwords changed on every device before connection
Physical access to restricted areas; visitor escort; key control
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Hold and evaluate product when controls or records are affected
Suspected tampering triggers food defense corrective action
Meet FSIS, FDA, and personal-data notification deadlines
Restore OT from clean backups and verify formulations
Annual tabletop including FSQA and Controls Engineer
Food defense plan in a restricted library plus onsite printed copy
Named, audited, locked electronic food safety records
Retention of HACCP, seafood HACCP, and food defense records
Isolated immutable backups including PLC programs; quarterly restore tests
Security and food defense awareness for all workers including temporary staff
No unapproved media or devices on HMIs or plant networks
Approved generative AI tools only; no Restricted data in unapproved tools
